increment.purpose: Await normal asynchronous termination within the existing 180-second budget before intentional fixture machine cleanup
scope: read-only polling of exact host-bound run set
each poll rechecks fixed deployment and Task identity, epoch and attempt bindings
frozen run identity validated on each read
HTTP request signal bounded by remaining wait budget
Task bindings rechecked before each single machine-end
no unknown-write retry; credential removal remains after cleanup

limitations: offline contracts are not production evidence
host machine-end acknowledgement is not independent provider observation
shared desktop GET cannot prove thread VM shutdown
